question: HA#559 OQ-2: the observability job sits in the release family, which carries no ladder, so an observability PR never shows an Observability row. Fix?

options.label: Keep exemption, say why ⭐ (Recommended)
options.consequence: Observability stays in the release family; the canon states in one place that this family skips the ladder and what that costs. No taxonomy change.

options.label: Move the job out
options.consequence: Observability moves to a family that carries the ladder, so its PRs show the Observability row. A taxonomy change; the job's family is re-ruled.
